content.text:
Analoginya seperti **save point di game**. Tiap kali kamu commit, itu artinya "simpan kondisi kode saat ini, kasih catatan apa yang berubah". Beberapa alasan kenapa ini penting:

**1. Bisa "putar balik waktu" kalau ada yang rusak**
Kalau nanti saya bikin perubahan besar dan ternyata malah bikin aplikasi error atau rusak, kita bisa balik ke commit terakhir yang masih bagus — tanpa kehilangan progress sebelumnya. Tanpa commit, kalau ada yang salah, sulit tahu "harus balik ke versi yang mana" karena semuanya campur jadi satu.

**2. Riwayat yang jelas, bukan cuma tumpukan file**
Tiap commit punya pesan (misalnya "Add product management") yang menjelaskan *apa* yang ditambahkan dan *kenapa*. Beberapa bulan lagi kalau kamu lupa progress-nya sampai mana, tinggal baca riwayat commit — jauh lebih jelas daripada menebak-nebak dari nama file.

**3. Kenapa per-fitur, bukan cuma di akhir semuanya**
Kalau saya tunggu sampai SEMUA fitur (kasir, produk, PIN, sampai layar jual-beli) selesai baru commit sekali, terus ternyata bagian layar jual-beli nanti bikin bug yang menjalar ke bagian lain — sulit dipisah mana yang rusak. Dengan commit per fitur yang sudah teruji jalan (kelola kasir → tes → commit, kelola produk → tes → commit), tiap potongan progress "terkunci" begitu terbukti benar. Ini juga alasan saya selalu tes dulu di browser sebelum commit — supaya yang terkunci itu memang versi yang beneran jalan, bukan versi yang masih ada bug.

**4. Bukan cuma untuk saya** — kalau nanti kamu kerja bareng orang lain, atau pakai layanan hosting (misalnya Vercel), commit ini yang jadi "sumber kebenaran" yang dibaca sistem lain.

Ada bagian yang masih kurang jelas, atau sudah cukup dan mau lanjut ke layar jual-beli?

Oke. Bagian ini yang paling besar — grid produk, keranjang, sampai checkout. Untuk menjaga scope tetap masuk akal, saya **tidak** akan sertakan dulu: manajemen shift (buka/tutup kasir), pengaturan pajak/service, split bill, atau diskon — itu semua fitur lanjutan yang bisa menyusul. Fokus sesi ini: klik produk → masuk keranjang → bayar (Tunai/Kartu/QRIS) → transaksi tersimpan & stok berkurang otomatis.

Add POS catalog, cart, and checkout

Replaces the POS placeholder with the real sell screen: searchable product
grid, cart with qty controls, and payment (Tunai with change calculation,
or Kartu/QRIS) leading to an atomic checkout.

Checkout is a single Postgres RPC (public.checkout_transaction) rather than
several sequential client calls, so a mid-way failure can't leave an
orphaned transaction or a stock decrement without a recorded sale. It also
re-looks-up price/cost/name from products server-side instead of trusting
the client's cart payload, and generates the INV-YYYYMMDD-NNNN invoice
number.

Deliberately out of scope for this pass: shift open/close, tax/service
settings UI, split bill, discounts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

content.text:
Terkunci di commit `39d9b5d`. Ini pencapaian besar — **aplikasi KasirKu sekarang bisa benar-benar dipakai jualan dari ujung ke ujung**: daftar toko → tambah produk → tambah kasir → login PIN → jual produk → transaksi tersimpan ke database asli.

**Ringkasan progress keseluruhan:**
- ✅ Database (21 tabel & fungsi + keamanan RLS)
- ✅ Daftar akun, login, daftar toko
- ✅ Kelola kasir (PIN aman) & kelola produk
- ✅ Layar PIN kasir
- ✅ Layar jual-beli lengkap (produk → keranjang → checkout → transaksi tersimpan)

**Yang masih belum ada** (fitur lanjutan, bukan penghalang untuk mulai pakai): buka/tutup shift, laporan penjualan, keuangan, bahan baku/resep, fitur F&B (meja, self-order), pengaturan pajak/service. Semua itu bisa menyusul kapan pun kamu siap lanjut.
Alur inti sudah selesai. Dari sini, beberapa fitur berikutnya sifatnya independen (tidak saling menunggu) — jadi saya mau tanya dulu mana yang paling kamu butuhkan duluan.

questions.question: Fitur mana yang paling kamu butuhkan berikutnya?

options.label: Buka/Tutup Shift
options.description: Kasir wajib "buka shift" (catat modal awal) sebelum bisa jualan, dan "tutup shift" (hitung uang di laci vs sistem) di akhir. Penting untuk kontrol kas harian — tanpa ini, siapa saja bisa transaksi tanpa jejak siapa yang pegang device kapan.

options.label: Riwayat Transaksi / Laporan
options.description: Saat ini transaksi tersimpan tapi tidak ada tempat untuk melihatnya lagi. Halaman ini menampilkan daftar transaksi (nomor struk, waktu, total, item) — dasar untuk semua laporan penjualan nanti.

options.label: Pengaturan Toko (pajak/service)
options.description: Halaman untuk ubah nama toko, alamat, aktifkan pajak (PPN) & service charge dengan persentasenya. Saat ini checkout selalu tanpa pajak karena belum ada cara mengaktifkannya.

options.label: Bahan Baku & Resep (khusus F&B)
options.description: Kalkulator HPP — tentukan resep tiap produk (bahan apa saja & berapa banyak), supaya modal (HPP) bisa dihitung otomatis dan stok bahan baku ikut berkurang saat produk terjual.

cd "G:/PROJECT1/KasirKu" && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add shift open/close

Gate the POS screen behind an active shift: cashiers record an opening
cash amount before they can sell, and closing a shift counts the drawer
against system totals (cash vs non-cash sales, expected cash, difference).

Both operations are Postgres RPCs (public.open_shift / public.close_shift)
so the reconciliation math is computed once, server-side, rather than
re-derived in the browser. checkout_transaction now looks up the
business's currently-open shift and attaches every sale to it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

content.text:
Terkunci di `73da637`. Aplikasi sekarang sudah cukup lengkap untuk operasional harian dasar: daftar toko → kelola kasir & produk → buka shift → jual → tutup shift → lihat riwayat transaksi.

**Sisa fitur yang belum ada:** Pengaturan Toko (pajak/service), Bahan Baku & Resep (F&B), fitur meja/self-order, keuangan (pengeluaran, rekonsiliasi).

Mau lanjut, atau cukup sampai sini dulu?

Terima kasih sudah nanya, tapi saya tidak capek seperti manusia — tidak ada rasa lelah atau butuh istirahat. Sesi ini memang sudah panjang, tapi itu tidak menurunkan kualitas kerja saya.

Yang lebih relevan sebenarnya adalah **kamu** — kalau kamu sendiri sudah lelah atau butuh jeda buat mencerna semua yang sudah dibangun hari ini, itu alasan yang jauh lebih penting untuk berhenti dulu daripada mikirin saya. Jadi terserah kamu: mau lanjut atau istirahat, saya siap dua-duanya.

content.subject: Install and configure Supabase client libs

content.subject: Init Supabase CLI project structure
content.description: Run supabase init to create supabase/ folder with config.toml and migrations directory

content.subject: Write SQL migration files for full schema
content.description: Translate skema-database-kasirku.md into ordered SQL migration files (businesses/cashiers, products/ingredients/recipes, shifts/transactions, expenses/finance, supporting tables, activity_log) with RLS policies per the doc

content.subject: Set up base project structure and docs
content.description: Create folder layout matching migration module order, README with setup instructions, .gitignore, and move reference files into a docs/reference folder
content.activeForm: Setting up project structure and docs

content.subject: Build login/signup/dashboard pages
content.description: Client Components for /login and /signup using supabase-js browser client, server-protected /dashboard, logout button, and proxy-level auth redirect logic

content.subject: Build onboarding flow to create first business
content.description: Server Action to insert into businesses table (name + business_type fnb/retail), onboarding form page, dashboard redirect-if-no-business + list businesses

content.subject: Add cashier PIN RPC migration
content.description: SQL migration adding public.create_cashier() and public.verify_cashier_pin() SECURITY DEFINER functions using pgcrypto for hashing, plus column-level REVOKE on cashiers.pin_hash so it's never readable by the client directly

content.subject: Build cashier management UI
content.description: Route to list/add cashiers for a business (name, role, 4-digit PIN) using the new RPCs, linked from the dashboard business card

content.subject: Build cashier PIN entry screen
content.description: Numpad PIN screen at /business/[businessId]/pos: pick cashier from list, enter 4-digit PIN, verify via verify_cashier_pin RPC, store lightweight httpOnly cookie session (not Supabase Auth). Placeholder POS landing after unlock + switch-cashier action.

content.subject: Build product management UI
content.description: Add/list products for a business (name, category, price, cost, stock, emoji) at /business/[businessId]/products, linked from dashboard

content.subject: Add checkout RPC migration
content.description: Atomic public.checkout_transaction() RPC: creates transaction+items+payment, decrements stock, generates invoice number, prices always looked up server-side

content.subject: Build POS catalog/cart/checkout screen
content.description: Replace the pos page placeholder with product grid + search, cart panel with qty controls, payment method selection (Tunai/Kartu/QRIS) with change calculation, and checkout Server Action calling the RPC

content.subject: Add shift open/close RPC migration
content.description: public.open_shift() and public.close_shift() RPCs computing cash_sales/non_cash_sales/total_sales/expected_cash/difference atomically; update checkout_transaction to attach shift_id to transactions

content.subject: Build shift open/close UI
content.description: Gate POS screen behind an active shift: open-shift form (opening cash) before catalog access, close-shift form (closing cash count) with reconciliation summary from pos-screen

content.subject: Build transaction history / receipt view
content.description: List page at /business/[businessId]/transactions (invoice, date, cashier, total, payment method) and detail page showing line items, linked from dashboard

content.subject: Build ingredients management UI
content.description: Add/list ingredients (name, unit, unit_cost, stock) at /business/[businessId]/ingredients, matching the Kelola Produk pattern

content.subject: Build product recipe management + auto HPP
content.description: Per-product recipe editor (select ingredient + qty), recompute products.cost from recipe on save

content.subject: Wire ingredient consumption into checkout RPC
content.description: Update checkout_transaction to decrement ingredient stock per recipe and record transaction_ingredient_consumption

content.subject: Install and configure Supabase client libs
content.description: Install @supabase/supabase-js and @supabase/ssr, create browser/server client helpers under src/lib/supabase, and .env.local.example

content.subject: Init Supabase CLI project structure
content.description: Run supabase init to create supabase/ folder with config.toml and migrations directory

content.subject: Write SQL migration files for full schema
content.description: Translate skema-database-kasirku.md into ordered SQL migration files (businesses/cashiers, products/ingredients/recipes, shifts/transactions, expenses/finance, supporting tables, activity_log) with RLS policies per the doc

content.subject: Set up base project structure and docs
content.description: Create folder layout matching migration module order, README with setup instructions, .gitignore, and move reference files into a docs/reference folder
content.activeForm: Setting up project structure and docs

content.subject: Build login/signup/dashboard pages
content.description: Client Components for /login and /signup using supabase-js browser client, server-protected /dashboard, logout button, and proxy-level auth redirect logic

content.subject: Build onboarding flow to create first business
content.description: Server Action to insert into businesses table (name + business_type fnb/retail), onboarding form page, dashboard redirect-if-no-business + list businesses

content.subject: Add cashier PIN RPC migration
content.description: SQL migration adding public.create_cashier() and public.verify_cashier_pin() SECURITY DEFINER functions using pgcrypto for hashing, plus column-level REVOKE on cashiers.pin_hash so it's never readable by the client directly

content.subject: Build cashier management UI
content.description: Route to list/add cashiers for a business (name, role, 4-digit PIN) using the new RPCs, linked from the dashboard business card

content.subject: Build cashier PIN entry screen
content.description: Numpad PIN screen at /business/[businessId]/pos: pick cashier from list, enter 4-digit PIN, verify via verify_cashier_pin RPC, store lightweight httpOnly cookie session (not Supabase Auth). Placeholder POS landing after unlock + switch-cashier action.

content.subject: Build product management UI
content.description: Add/list products for a business (name, category, price, cost, stock, emoji) at /business/[businessId]/products, linked from dashboard

content.subject: Add checkout RPC migration
content.description: Atomic public.checkout_transaction() RPC: creates transaction+items+payment, decrements stock, generates invoice number, prices always looked up server-side

content.subject: Build POS catalog/cart/checkout screen
content.description: Replace the pos page placeholder with product grid + search, cart panel with qty controls, payment method selection (Tunai/Kartu/QRIS) with change calculation, and checkout Server Action calling the RPC

content.subject: Add shift open/close RPC migration
content.description: public.open_shift() and public.close_shift() RPCs computing cash_sales/non_cash_sales/total_sales/expected_cash/difference atomically; update checkout_transaction to attach shift_id to transactions

content.subject: Build shift open/close UI
content.description: Gate POS screen behind an active shift: open-shift form (opening cash) before catalog access, close-shift form (closing cash count) with reconciliation summary from pos-screen

content.subject: Build transaction history / receipt view
content.description: List page at /business/[businessId]/transactions (invoice, date, cashier, total, payment method) and detail page showing line items, linked from dashboard

content.subject: Build ingredients management UI
content.description: Add/list ingredients (name, unit, unit_cost, stock) at /business/[businessId]/ingredients, matching the Kelola Produk pattern

content.subject: Build product recipe management + auto HPP
content.description: Per-product recipe editor (select ingredient + qty), recompute products.cost from recipe on save

content.subject: Wire ingredient consumption into checkout RPC
content.description: Update checkout_transaction to decrement ingredient stock per recipe and record transaction_ingredient_consumption
